thread:
devon_csm: @horizon_ops :wave: kicking off onboarding for Horizon Retail. Quick agenda: 1) align on success criteria, 2) confirm milestones/timeline, 3) tech & data contacts, 4) enablement plan. Proposed pilot target: ~4 weeks (by 2026-04-20).

horizon_ops: Thanks @devon_csm! Sounds good. Primary success criteria: 1) <10% false positives on intent classification, 2) <200ms median latency in production, 3) customer satisfaction >85% in pilot. Targeting go-live for select stores.

jessy_se: Adding engineering notes — we'll need sandbox API keys, sample POS logs (anonymized), and a list of top 50 intents. ETA to ingest sample data: 3 business days after keys.

liam_engineering: I can own the sandbox setup. @horizon_ops can you share S3 bucket or secure upload? Also confirm sequence length expectations for receipts (avg tokens ~120?).

horizon_ops: Will do. We have a secure SFTP we can use; can also grant temporary S3 access. Receipts are variable but median ~90 tokens, max ~600.

karen_enable: For enablement: propose two enablement sessions — 1) admin & routing (30m) 2) advanced prompt tuning + evals (45m). We should capture a 10-item prompt test set during pilot.

rafael_cs_manager: High-level timeline proposal: Week 0: kickoff & access; Week 1: sandbox ingest + smoke tests; Week 2: model tuning & integrations; Week 3: pilot validation & QA; Week 4: pilot wrap + success review. Concerns: if data handoff slips >1 week, pilot may shift and renewal signals could weaken for Q3.

devon_csm: Noted @rafael_cs_manager — renewal sensitivity captured. We'll add a milestone to flag risk if sandbox not ingested by EOD Week 1. Also assign escalation owner.

horizon_ops: Who should we list as escalation contact from Redwood side?

devon_csm: Primary: @devon_csm, Secondary: @rafael_cs_manager. Technical escalation: @liam_engineering.

onboard-bot: calendar invite created: "Horizon Retail — Onboarding Weekly" recurring Wednesdays 10:00am PT starting 2026-03-26. Invite: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123

jessy_se: Quick config snippet for sandbox auth (paste in case useful):
```
API_KEY=redwood-sandbox-XXXX
ENDPOINT=https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

karen_enable: Action items from this thread: 1) horizon_ops -> upload sample data to SFTP by 2026-03-24; 2) liam -> provision sandbox keys by 2026-03-22; 3) devon -> send enablement calendar + 10-item prompt template by 2026-03-23.

horizon_ops: Confirmed. We'll aim to upload by 03/24 and share the contact for SFTP tonight.

devon_csm: Great — I'll follow up with a brief onboarding checklist in DMs and tag this thread for status updates. If anything blocks, please @mention me. :thumbsup:

liam_engineering: One more tech note — we'll run an initial load test at t=0 with 100 concurrent virtual users to validate latency. If median >250ms, we'll toggle a caching policy and re-run.

rafael_cs_manager: Good call. I'll monitor the stakeholder health score and share a renewal-risk note in our CRM if we hit the Week 1 ingestion blocker.

devon_csm: Thanks everyone — meeting invite + checklist coming shortly. Looking forward to a smooth pilot! :rocket:
